does_not_do: It reads public filings only. Version 6 needs Python 3.11 or newer and changes some 5.x APIs.
focus_reason: It covers parsing as well as download, has regression tests against live filings, and shipped 128 releases in the year with 32 open issues.
measured_against: Need: read SEC EDGAR filings and their financial data into structured form.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; regression-test and smoke-test workflows against recent filings.
what_it_is: A Python library that turns SEC EDGAR filings into typed objects: financial statements, XBRL, insider trades, fund holdings and other filing types.
